generic_sampling_rules.int_primary_key: sequential unique integers starting at 1; never NULL
generic_sampling_rules.int_foreign_key: sample from parent id pool that survives PK/unique filtering; 5-30% NULL when nullable; include parent rows without children
generic_sampling_rules.int_quantity: positive integers; include boundary values and one step on each side of listed literals
generic_sampling_rules.int_general: integers within observed min/max; include min, max, and near-boundary values
generic_sampling_rules.real_measure: real numbers within observed min/max; include min, max, and one step on each side
generic_sampling_rules.text_short: short text values; include near-variants (case, whitespace, one-char edits) of listed literals
generic_sampling_rules.text_enum: sample from explicit enum pool; include all listed values
generic_sampling_rules.text_date: date strings in 'D Month YYYY' format; include boundary dates one day on each side of listed literals
generic_sampling_rules.text_score: score strings like 'N–M' or 'N–M (P:Q)'; include near-variants of listed literals
generic_sampling_rules.text_nullable: non-NULL text values; 5-30% NULL when nullable
generic_sampling_rules.distinct_share: for DISTINCT-target columns, ensure duplicate share 20-50%
generic_sampling_rules.group_sizes: for GROUP-target columns, ensure group sizes of 1, 2, and >=3
generic_sampling_rules.aggregate_boundary: for HAVING COUNT targets, ensure groups with counts 1, 2, and >=3
generic_sampling_rules.comparison_boundary: for comparison targets, include exact literal, one step below, one step above, and case variants
generic_sampling_rules.null_share: for every nullable column (including nullable FKs), plant at least one NULL row and a share within the compact DB's null_share band (5-30% when the compact share is 0); never replace a planted NULL to satisfy a rule; rules and formulas constrain only non-NULL operands
generic_sampling_rules.column_length_invariant: all columns of a table must have equal length; boundary literals are placed by overwriting existing positions, never by appending
generic_sampling_rules.fk_integrity: every non-NULL FK value must exist in the parent table after PK/unique filtering; draw FK values only from surviving parent keys, and validate after insert

uncertainty: Total_Attendance formula holds approximately (rounding differences of up to 4); stated with condition Home_Games > 0. Home_Games observed as constant 8 (statistics distinct=1) but the rows_with_different_values target requires variation: Home_Games may vary (e.g. 1..12) to satisfy that target, and Total_Attendance must then be recomputed per row as Average_Attendance * Home_Games. Season range 2000-2030 is a loose bound from observed 2007-2013. Score shape (dash, parenthetical penalties, en dash) is uncertain / not enforced; group_sizes and aggregate_boundary on game.Score are best-effort. game.Date group_sizes and aggregate_boundary are best-effort within the 'D Month YYYY' format. Group-size and duplicate-share shaping on stadium.name and game.Date/Score must be applied in a single pass that satisfies both targets simultaneously.
